args.title: Add TSV export support to the reports endpoint
args.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

The reports endpoint currently supports CSV and XLSX export formats. To align with the warehouse loader's requirement for tab-delimited files, add TSV support to the `renderExport` function and update the `SUPPORTED_FORMATS` validation to include TSV. This will allow users to export reports directly in TSV format, avoiding manual conversion errors caused by commas in transaction descriptions.
